title: More ways to generate text and images
summary:
New chat and image options, private text requests, and three community projects made for a varied day in the garden.

Hormoz 8B was added for chat with temperature and JSON-mode support. The turbo image model was enabled with prompt enhancement and a 768-pixel maximum side length.

Text requests gained a `private=true` option that keeps responses off the public feed, and the model list gained `deepseek-reasoner` while retiring `qwen`. OpenAI-style responses also now have consistent `pllns_` IDs, completion objects, and choice indexes.

ElliotEtag added the browser-based coding assistant pollinations.diy to the monorepo. The project listings also gained @brain.diver’s MIDI melody maker PolliSonic Generator and withthatway’s multimodel chatbot urSapere AI.

highlights.title: Hormoz 8B joins chat
highlights.text: Chat with Hormoz 8B, with temperature control and JSON-mode support. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=hormoz).

highlights.title: Turbo image generation
highlights.text: Generate images with `turbo`, including prompt enhancement and a maximum side length of 768 pixels. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=turbo).

highlights.title: DeepSeek R1 Full
highlights.text: Use `deepseek-reasoner` for DeepSeek R1 Full text generation. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-reasoner).

highlights.title: Keep text off the feed
highlights.text: Set `private=true` in a text request’s GET query or POST body to skip broadcasting its response to the public feed. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
